# Test fixtures

JSON has no comments, so each fixture is described here. Everything is small and hand-built or generated; the real recordings live in `/fixtures`.

| File | What it contains |
| --- | --- |
| `webperf-snippets.har.fixture.json` | Trimmed Chrome HAR of webperf-snippets.nucliweb.net. |
| `webperf-snippets.trace.fixture.json`, `webperf-snippets-render.trace.fixture.json` | Trimmed Chrome performance traces of the same page. |
| `redirect-iframe.har.fixture.json` | Chrome HAR with a document redirect chain and an HTML iframe. |
| `network-problems.har.fixture.json` | Chrome HAR with network problems (redirect chains and similar) for the network report. |
| `flow-v0.fixture.json`, `flow-v2.fixture.json` | Saved flows of older versions, for the migrations. |
| `wpt-first-repeat.har.fixture.json` | WebPageTest export, 2 runs x first + repeat view (`page_1_0_1`, `page_1_1_1`, `page_2_0_1`, `page_2_1_1`). First views have 10 entries with a mix of lifetimes (`no-cache`, `max-age=0`, 30 min to 1 year, `no-store`); repeat views have 5 entries (document, two 304s, a `no-store` beacon and an API call) and omit the 6 fresh resources a browser serves from its cache, which the parser infers. Carries WebPageTest's `_` extras. |
| `firefox.har.fixture.json` | Firefox DevTools export, 12 entries: HTTP/2, no `_transferSize`, `_priority`, `_initiator` or `_resourceType`, sizes only in `bodySize` and `headersSize`, `-1` timing phases, a 304 with `cache.afterRequest`, a cached entry with `cache.beforeRequest`, an empty mime type and an `application/octet-stream` response. |
| `multi-cdn.har.fixture.json` | Chrome HAR with 15 entries on three CDNs: the document on Cloudflare (`cf-ray` with the FRA PoP), static assets on Fastly (`x-served-by` ending in MAD, `x-cache`), images on Akamai (`x-akamai-transformed`, `x-cache`, `server-timing: cdn-cache; desc=HIT`, one miss), Google Fonts behind Google Front End, and a third party with no CDN. |
| `large.har.fixture.json.gz` | 1,500 entries on 40 hosts, generated by `packages/core/scripts/gen-large-har.mjs` (seeded, so the bytes never change). |
